description: Dadabhoy Cement Industries Limited was incorporated in August 1979 to build a 1,000 tonnes per day Portland cement plant — the first cement plant fabricated in Pakistan, by the Heavy Mechanical Complex at Taxila — at Kalu Kohar in Dadu District, Sindh, about 84 kilometres from Karachi on the Super Highway. It began commercial production in 1986, subsequently raised plant capacity to 1,800 tonnes per day, and was among the first in Pakistan to introduce slag cement. Per its group, it produces in excess of half a million tonnes of cement a year.
